generated: 2026-10-20, offline, by cs2mcp session (parse of the .Prefab files in the mods' .cok packs; Game.Prefabs.Bridge serialised fields)
derivation: NetInitializeSystem: segmentLength > 0.1 -> edge length 0.6..1.4 x segmentLength (min dropped if allowMinimalLength), otherwise the base net range; fixed spans: each 0.6..1.4 x its length when all lengths > 0.1, exact length if any span has length 0; countRange components equal to 0 mean 0 / 10000 (unbounded); canCurve false -> StraightEdges; fixed span canCurve false -> straight span. elevationOnWater -> PlaceableNetData.m_MinWaterElevation (used by the net tool to raise the deck over water; not a validation error).
importContract: Fixed-span prefab: ONE /import/network edge abutment to abutment, length within importEdge.lengthMin..lengthMax (nominal = design length); the game (CourseSplitSystem) cuts it into the spans, sets Fixed.m_Index 0..n-1 and scales the spans in proportion. Non-fixed bridge prefab: any edge >= edgeLengthRange.min; longer than max is cut into ceil((L-0.16)/max) equal pieces by the game. All bridge prefabs require elevation >= 2 x the net elevation limit at an end or the middle (LowElevation error). See cs2mcp/IMPORT_SCHEMA.md "Bridge prefabs".
vanilla: Not readable offline (definitions live in resources.assets). Read in game with GET /prefabs/info?name=<prefab> (bridge block, 0.9.22): e.g. "Suspension Bridge - Highway Oneway - 3 lanes", "Truss Arch Bridge - Highway Twoway - 2 Lanes", "Wooden Covered Bridge - 2 lanes", "Arc Pedestrian Bridge", "TrussArchBridge01", "SuspensionBridge03".
caveats: class read from the prefab header; names are the prefab "name" field (some files are named without the BXP prefix)
whether BXP loads on the current game build is unverified (DECISIONS.md)
